documents.title: Extra Ordinary General Meeting ('EOGM') Of The Members Of U. Y. Fincorp Limited Will Be Held On Wednesday, The 25Th Day Of November, 2026 At 11:00 A.M.

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong financial and operational performance for FY 2025-26, driven by growth in revenue from operations, profit before tax, and total assets. The company expanded its lending portfolio, diversified its product offerings by introducing Equipment Financing under the "GrowU.money" brand, and expanded outreach through strategic partnerships such as with Fintech Cloud Private Limited under the "Fundobaba" brand. Management emphasized its commitment to prudent credit appraisal, robust risk management, technological integration, and financial inclusion while navigating competitive markets and evolving regulatory environments. Management reported that real GDP growth was estimated at 6.5% for FY 2024-25 and discussed the expansion of operations into newer loan segments under the brand name "GrowU.Money" in Uttar Pradesh. The company recorded revenue from operations of ` 11,104.61 Lakhs and a profit before tax of ` 1,693.88 Lakhs for the financial year.

guidance.claim: Management stated that global GDP growth is expected to remain low at 3% for 2024.
guidance.quote: Global GDP growth is expected to remain low at 3% for 2024.

guidance.claim: Management noted that inflation has softened over the highs of the previous year and is expected to continue to moderate.
guidance.quote: Encouragingly, inflation has softened over the highs of the previous year and is expected to continue to moderate.

guidance.claim: Demand for credit is projected to grow by 13.5-14.0 per cent.
guidance.quote: As the country progresses, demand for credit is likely to remain strong, especially among Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) and retail, and is projected to grow by 13.5-14.0 per cent.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Indian economy maintained strong growth momentum during FY 2025-26, supported by domestic consumption, investment activity, manufacturing, and services.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian economy maintained strong growth momentum during FY 2025-26, supported by domestic consumption, investment activity, manufacturing and services.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that increasing formalisation of the economy, financial inclusion, digitalisation, and growing demand for organised credit have created significant opportunities for NBFCs.
demand_outlook.quote: Increasing formalisation of the economy, financial inclusion, digitalisation and growing demand for organised credit have created significant opportunities for NBFCs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that India's continued economic development, formalisation of businesses, increasing penetration of organised credit, and growth of MSMEs provide a favourable long-term opportunity for the business.
demand_outlook.quote: India's continued economic development, formalisation of businesses, increasing penetration of organised credit and growth of MSMEs provide a favourable long-term opportunity for our business.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the growing financing requirements of businesses and individuals, increasing financial inclusion, digital adoption, and formalisation of economic activity provide a strong foundation for the future of financial intermediation.
demand_outlook.quote: The growing financing requirements of businesses and individuals, increasing financial inclusion, digital adoption and the continuing formalisation of economic activity provide a strong foundation for the future of financial intermediation.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the predicted slowdown in growth is aligned to pervasive uncertainty in the global economy.
demand_outlook.quote: According to the Second Advance Estimates (SAE) by the National Statistics Office (NSO), real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is estimated to have grown at 6.5% in FY 2024-25, on top of a 9.2% growth in FY 2023-24. The predicted slowdown in growth is aligned to the pervasive uncertainty in the global economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that demand for credit is likely to remain strong, especially among MSMEs and retail.
demand_outlook.quote: As the country progresses, demand for credit is likely to remain strong, especially among Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) and retail, and is projected to grow by 13.5-14.0 per cent.

demand_outlook.claim: The pilot project for 'GrowU. Money' in Lucknow and Kanpur has received positive responses.
demand_outlook.quote: Expansion of business operations into newer loan segments under the New Brand name “GrowU. Money” has received positive response under its pilot project in the areas of lucknow and Kanpur, it is now inter alia expanding further into central and eastern Uttar Pradesh covering Prayagraj, Varanasi, Sonbhadra, Ayodhya, Deoria and Gorakhpur regions.

capex_expansion.claim: Management reported entering into a contractual joint venture agreement with Fintech Cloud Private Limited on April 9, 2025, for the expansion of business into small ticket size personal and business loans under the brand name "FUNDOBABA".
capex_expansion.quote: During the period under review, the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on 9th April, 2025, inter alia considered and approved the contractual joint venture agreement dated 9th April, 2025 entered into by the Company with Fintech Cloud Private Limited (FCPL) for expansion of its business into the field on small ticket size Personal and Business Loan under its new brand name “FUNDOBABA”.

capex_expansion.claim: The Company approved opening a new branch office at Lucknow for business expansion under "GrowU.Money".
capex_expansion.quote: During the year under review, the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 3rd May, 2024 inter alia considered and approved the proposal of opening of the Company’s new branch office at Lucknow for the purpose of expansion of its business operation in the area of Lucknow under the brand name “GrowU.Money”.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved a contractual joint venture agreement with Fintech Cloud Private Limited for expanding into small ticket size personal and business loans under "FUNDOBABA".
capex_expansion.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on 9th April, 2025, inter alia considered and approved the contractual joint venture agreement dated 9th April, 2025 entered into by the Company with Fintech Cloud Private Limited (FCPL) for expansion of its business into the field on small ticket size Personal and Business Loan under its new brand name “FUNDOBABA”.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding its 'GrowU. Money' operations into central and eastern Uttar Pradesh covering Prayagraj, Varanasi, Sonbhadra, Ayodhya, Deoria, and Gorakhpur regions.
capex_expansion.quote: Expansion of business operations into newer loan segments under the New Brand name “GrowU. Money” has received positive response under its pilot project in the areas of lucknow and Kanpur, it is now inter alia expanding further into central and eastern Uttar Pradesh covering Prayagraj, Varanasi, Sonbhadra, Ayodhya, Deoria and Gorakhpur regions.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into various Business Correspondent Agreements for business expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company had also entered into various Business Correspondent Agreements for expansion of its business.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to launch loans against property to diversify its offerings.
capex_expansion.quote: To further diversify its offerings, the Company is set to launch a new product – loans against property.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported that the lending portfolio reached ₹35,652.97 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026, compared with ₹27,457.34 Lakhs as at March 31, 2025.
orders_capacity.quote: Our lending portfolio also expanded meaningfully during the year, reaching ₹35,652.97 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026, compared with ₹27,457.34 Lakhs as at March 31, 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the company has disbursed loans to more than 18,000 customers across India.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company has disbursed loans to more than 18,000 customers across India.

orders_capacity.claim: The company disbursed loans to more than 3,800 customers across Uttar Pradesh through its network of 2 branches and 6 Business Correspondents.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company had disbursed loan to more than 3,800 customers, across more than 2 Customer Locations in Uttar Pradesh, through its network of 2 branches, & 6 Business Correspondents.

orders_capacity.claim: The company digitalized the onboarding disbursement process of small ticket sized loans with a monthly run rate of approximately Rs. 100 Lakhs.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company has also digitalized the onboarding disbusrement process of small ticket sized Loan with the monthly run rate of approx Rs. 100 Lakhs with an interest rate ranging between 24-33% p.a.

orders_capacity.claim: The company built a loan portfolio exceeding 14 crore INR while keeping the NPA rate below 2 percent within one year.
orders_capacity.quote: In just one year, Company has built a loan portfolio exceeding 14 crore INR keeping the NPA rate below 2 percent.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that no dividend was recommended for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, in order to plough back resources for future growth.
capital_allocation.quote: The Directors of your Company do not recommend any dividend for the financial year ended 31st March, 2026 in order to plough back the resources for future growth.

capital_allocation.claim: The directors did not recommend any dividend for the financial year ended 31st March, 2024 in order to plough back resources for future growth.
capital_allocation.quote: The Directors of your Company do not recommend any dividend for the financial year ended 31st March, 2024 in order to plough back the resources for future growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the industry continues to face challenges relating to asset quality, competition, funding conditions, interest-rate movements, and an evolving regulatory environment.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, the industry continues to face challenges relating to asset quality, competition, funding conditions, interest-rate movements and an evolving regulatory environment.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management recognized that the operating environment will remain competitive and subject to evolving regulations, credit risks, interest-rate movements, and changes in the broader economic cycle.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, we also recognise that the operating environment will remain competitive and subject to evolving regulations, credit risks, interest-rate movements and changes in the broader economic cycle.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted ongoing geopolitical conflicts, widespread elevation of debt, extreme weather conditions, and global elections as factors contributing to global economic uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: Multiple factors like the on-going geopolitical conflicts, wide-spread elevation of debt, extreme weather conditions and elections in many parts of the world continue to contribute to the uncertainty of the Global Economic Outlook.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to expand operations in existing markets, selectively enter newer geographies, and explore organic as well as inorganic opportunities within its risk appetite.
management_commitments.quote: We intend to build upon our existing strengths by expanding our operations in existing markets, selectively entering newer geographies and exploring organic as well as inorganic opportunities, while remaining within our risk appetite.

management_commitments.claim: The Company intends to continue its efforts of mainstreaming financial inclusion and providing affordable credit to customers in the lower half of the socio-economic pyramid.
management_commitments.quote: The Company intends to continue its efforts of mainstreaming financial inclusion and providing affordable credit to customers in the lower half of the socio-economic pyramid.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
